name: ship-pipeline
description: Fourteen repo-agnostic skills for the ship half of the development loop: issue intake, live-schema grounding, evidence-backed verification, report-only slop review, review/PR/merge, production promotion, a batch orchestrator that carries several issues through all of it, build conventions for API routes, Stripe billing, and PostHog analytics, and a visual UX review of screenshots. Every skill detects the repo's own conventions; the shipping-loop skills (start-issue through ship-issues) defer to a repo-local override when one exists.
